t: The Erbauer 57mm multi-material holesaw is a robust cutting tool engineered for professional tradespeople. This HSS M42 bi-metal holesaw features an 8% cobalt alloy, ensuring exceptional durability and a long service life across demanding tasks. Its sharp teeth, with varied pitches, deliver a smooth, fast, and efficient cut through diverse materials including wood, laminate, stainless steel, sheet metal, and plastic. This makes it ideal for electricians installing conduits or plumbers creating pipework openings. A maximum cutting depth of 38mm allows for versatile applications, and the slotted steel barrel aids in quick debris removal, maintaining productivity on site. Suitable for use with 1/2" chucks.
b: Cuts Wood, Laminate, Stainless Steel, Sheet Metal & Plastic
Steel Slotted Barrel to Aid Removal of Debris
For 1/2" Chucks - Use with Pilot Drill
HSS M42 Bi-Metal & 8% Cobalt Alloy for Durability
Sharp Teeth & Varied Pitches for Smooth, Fast Cuts
38mm Max Cutting Depth for Versatile Use
